**Issue:** The docstring says lines are filled "if the resulting line is at most ``width`` characters long" (implying `<= width`), but the code uses `< width` in the packing condition. This discrepancy needs to be resolved.

**Required changes:**
1. Update the docstring to accurately describe the new packing logic (using `<` instead of `<=`)
2. Add a comment explaining why `<` is used instead of `<=` in the packing condition

The functional logic is sound and will pass all tests, but the documentation must be corrected to match the implementation.
